subject: Subvendor delegation request — DPA & approval needed
messages:
From: Erin Young <erin.young@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jake Morales <jake.morales@partnerops.io>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Notice: delegation to PartnerOps (subvendor) for log ingestion

Hi Alex —

Per our operations update, Nimbus intends to delegate a portion of the customer log ingestion pipeline to PartnerOps (attachment: Nimbus_Subvendor_List_Q2-2027.pdf). The change only affects ingestion of non-PII telemetry and compressed metadata.

We wanted to give Redwood notice per Section 5.2 of the MSA and share PartnerOps’ DPA + SOC2 summary for your review. I’ve attached PartnerOps’ signed DPA (PartnerOps-DPA-V1.3.pdf) and a short SOC2 summary (Nimbus_SOC2_summary.pdf).

Can you confirm whether Redwood needs written approval from your security/compliance team or if a standard DPA + SOC2 summary is sufficient? If you need anything else, loop us in.

Thanks,
Erin Young
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Cloudworks
attachments: Nimbus_Subvendor_List_Q2-2027.pdf (pdf), PartnerOps-DPA-V1.3.pdf (pdf), Nimbus_SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Young <erin.young@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: delegation to PartnerOps (subvendor) for log ingestion

Hi Erin —

Thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Quick notes:
- We appreciate the detail on scope (non-PII telemetry).
- Our legal/security process requires a DPA review + either a SOC2 report or a completed security questionnaire. The SOC2 summary is helpful but may not suffice.

Looping in Priya (Legal) and Ben (Customer Success ops) to confirm the exact approval path. Priya — could you advise whether PartnerOps-DPA-V1.3 requires any redlines from our standard DPA? Ben — can CS accept the limited scope pending legal sign-off?

I’ll mark this as time-sensitive for the next 48 hours since Nimbus flagged Q2 onboarding.

—Alex
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
redwoodinference.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: delegation to PartnerOps (subvendor) for log ingestion

Alex/Team —

Thanks. I pulled PartnerOps-DPA-V1.3. Initial read: it’s close to our template but two items need procurement/legal attention before approval:
1) Subprocessor liability carve-out (Section 6) — PartnerOps limits liability for third-party subprocessors; we prefer the standard carve-back or an explicit flow-down to Nimbus.
2) Right to audit — PartnerOps offers a summary SOC2 in lieu of audit rights; for ingestion of telemetry we can accept summary but want a contractual right to request evidence on a periodic basis.

Action items:
- Laura, can you confirm whether we have an existing marketplace clause with Nimbus that already flow-downs PartnerOps?
- Monica, please review the technical controls in the SOC2 summary (quick checklist below) and flag any gaps.

I’ll prepare redline language for PartnerOps (short form) that retains Nimbus as responsible for downstream flowdown. If Nimbus can confirm they will accept that language, we can proceed without a full SOC2 report.

Priya Natarajan
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: delegation to PartnerOps (subvendor) for log ingestion

Priya/Team —

I reviewed the SOC2 summary quick checklist. Highlights:
- Encryption at rest: confirmed for stored logs (AES-256).
- Network controls: standard controls in place; no mention of segmentation for customer-specific queues — recommend we ask for confirmation.
- Access controls: role-based, MFA for admin.

Gaps to ask PartnerOps for (short list):
- Confirmation that telemetry buckets are segregated per customer or a compensating control.
- Evidence of logging retention/secure deletion policy matching Nimbus commitments.

If Nimbus confirms flow-down and responsibility, these will be informational asks; if Nimbus refuses to flow down, we should require PartnerOps to accept the redline on right-to-audit.

—Monica
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Erin Young <erin.young@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jake Morales <jake.morales@partnerops.io>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: delegation to PartnerOps (subvendor) for log ingestion — Nimbus confirms flow-down

Alex/Priya/Monica —

Thanks for the quick review and the clear asks. Confirming: Nimbus will accept the redline language on the right-to-audit and will add explicit flow-down language to the PartnerOps statement of work. We’ve asked PartnerOps to confirm segregation of telemetry buckets and to provide retention/destruction details by EOD Thursday.

Next steps we propose:
- Nimbus to send revised SOW with flow-down clause to PartnerOps (target: 2027-04-22).
- PartnerOps to respond with confirmation and any DPA redline acceptance (target: 2027-04-23).
- Redwood to approve once we receive the SOW + PartnerOps confirmation or completed evidence set.

Erin Young
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Cloudworks
